name: Sphere
image_description: Audience surrounded by a large immersive visual canvas at Sphere in Las Vegas
challenge: Deliver complex productions across an immersive venue with a very large, unusual visual canvas.
how_disguise_helps: The source deck describes Disguise as Sphere’s in-house visual experience platform, with collaboration between Disguise and the venue’s creative and technical teams.
outcome: One integrated approach for ambitious visual productions, with the platform also used for real-time brand activations on the Exosphere.
